title: Senate Armed Services Committee (SASC) on Emerging Threats and Capabilities Briefing Slides 2023
doc_notes: This document consists of briefing slides from the All-Domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO) dated April 2023, providing statistical trends and characteristics of UAP reports from 1996-2023 rather than specific incident reports. / This document consists of a single briefing slide from the Senate Armed Services Committee regarding UAP observations in the Middle East. / This document consists of briefing slides from the Senate Armed Services Committee regarding UAP observations, specifically detailing an AARO analysis of an MQ-9 sensor event.
